# The Bureau of Provisions

> A stainless steel bottle design with a folding steel straw, wide drinking spout and optional mist. The first release is in development; final dimensions, capacity and colours are to be confirmed.

## Product

- [The bottle](https://bureauofprovisions.web.app/#ways): Six interactive feature descriptions: mist, straw, spout, one continuous detachable carry strap with clip-on snap hooks, double-wall stainless steel and dishwasher-safe cleaning.
- [Anatomy and specifications](https://bureauofprovisions.web.app/#specifications): An illustrative half-cutaway and material specifications. Final physical measurements are to be confirmed.
- [Two-tone colour studies](https://bureauofprovisions.web.app/#colourways): Nineteen brighter palettes and striped strap studies for ages 6–10. Includes princess, football, space and superhero palette editions. Colours change only; the original bottle geometry and one continuous detachable carry strap with clip-on snap hooks are preserved.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://bureauofprovisions.web.app/sitemap.xml): Canonical page URL.
